# Shopify Product and Collection Optimization

## Audit before editing
- Inspect product types, vendors, tags, collections, variants, images, inventory tracking, metafields, and existing navigation.
- Identify duplicate, inconsistent, incomplete, or misleading data.
- Do not bulk-edit or delete products, variants, collections, or inventory without explicit approval.
- Preserve handles and URLs unless a redirect plan is approved.

## Product page standards
- Use accurate product titles and concise descriptions based only on supplied specifications.
- Include clear image alt text and consistent image ordering.
- Show variant availability, price, compare-at price only when valid, and stock status from actual Shopify data.
- Avoid unsupported claims about quality, compatibility, warranty, delivery, or authenticity.
- Use structured metafields for repeatable specifications instead of embedding everything in description HTML.
- Ensure variant selection updates price, image, availability, and add-to-cart state correctly.

## Collection and discovery
- Organize collections around genuine product taxonomy and customer intent.
- Keep collection titles, descriptions, filters, and sort options consistent.
- Test filtering and sorting with real catalog records, including empty and low-result states.
- Ensure search suggestions and no-results states remain useful.
- For Retail Hub-Store, retain Mobile Accessories and exclude a Mobile Phones category unless the owner explicitly changes that requirement.

## Merchandising and conversion
- Prioritize clear product imagery, price, variant choices, delivery/COD information, and add-to-cart.
- Make related products and cross-sells relevant; do not add unrelated upsells.
- Ensure discounts and compare-at prices are mathematically and factually valid.
- Do not invent ratings, reviews, stock urgency, shipping times, or customer benefits.

## Bulk operations
- Preview a sample and show the proposed mapping before bulk changes.
- Export or preserve a rollback snapshot when possible.
- Process in small batches, inspect errors, and verify representative records after each batch.
- Report changed product IDs/handles and any skipped records.
